findings.title: Chest pain with associated features
findings.statement: Potential warning sign: chest pain is documented together with other symptoms that warrant prompt clinical evaluation.

explanation.what: Chest pain is recorded together with breathlessness, sweating, radiation, nausea and/or syncope.
explanation.why: Chest pain has cardiac and non-cardiac causes; the combination of features raises the priority of review. This rule flags for review only and makes no diagnosis.
explanation.action: Clinician to assess promptly and decide on appropriate investigation.

findings.statement: Potential warning sign: high respiratory rate (26 breaths/min).

explanation.what: Respiratory rate of 26 breaths/min recorded on 2026-09-19 is at or above 25 breaths/min.
explanation.why: Single-parameter extreme-band rule. Thresholds are configurable demo values adapted from early-warning-score extreme bands; they are not clinically validated.
explanation.action: Clinician to verify the measurement and assess the patient in context.

findings.reviewNote: Review required — the decision rests with the treating clinician.

findings.title: Low oxygen saturation
findings.statement: Potential warning sign: low oxygen saturation (90 %).

explanation.what: SpO₂ of 90 % recorded on 2026-09-19 is at or below 91 %.
explanation.why: Single-parameter extreme-band rule. Thresholds are configurable demo values adapted from early-warning-score extreme bands; they are not clinically validated. explanation.action: Clinician to verify the measurement and assess the patient in context.
